name: discord-patched-electron
description: Build and package Discord's native Electron integration

scripts.lint: uv run ruff check . && oxlint integration tests && uv run python scripts/check_style.py && oxfmt --check . && uv run ruff format --check .
scripts.format: uv run ruff format . && uv run ruff check --fix . && uv run ruff format . && oxfmt --write . && uv run python scripts/check_style.py --fix
scripts.test: uv run python -m unittest discover -s tests -v && node --test tests/audio/*.test.cjs
